canonicalJson: UTF-8 without escapes, sorted keys, 2-space indent, LF, one trailing newline, numbers to at most three decimals
description: Fixtures for the Plannotation 0.1 page-label schema. Every document under valid/ must validate against schema; every document under invalid/ must fail with exactly one error, of the stated keyword, at the stated errorPath (python-jsonschema json_path syntax). schemaPointer is a JSON Pointer that dereferences to the failing keyword in the schema file; validatorSchemaPath is the same rule as python-jsonschema renders it, with $ref hops elided.
